summary: Tenax Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a supply agreement with Orion Corporation for orally administered levosimendan product, and a sixth amendment to the existing license agreement extending the regulatory approval deadline to December 31, 2035, and adding cybersecurity requirements. The supply agreement has a five-year initial term with automatic renewals, includes cost-sharing for manufacturing scale-up, and standard termination provisions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation event occurred. This is a routine current report regarding a material definitive agreement for supply and licensing, not a special situation.
